title: Croatian Shallots Skewers
description: A briny and snappy Croatian dish featuring shallots, perfect for festive occasions, this sugar-free-friendly recipe is smoked to perfection and served cold.
instructions: Preheat the smoker to 100 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the peeled and trimmed shallots to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated shallots onto skewers, leaving a small space between each shallot.
Smoke the shallots for 30 minutes, or until they are tender and slightly caramelized.
Remove the shallots from the smoker and let them cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate the shallots for at least 2 hours to allow them to chill and set.
Just before serving, sprinkle the chopped parsley over the shallots.
Serve the Croatian shallots skewers cold, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
